facts.fact: Adwave states that a professionally made TV ad can be placed on air in a few minutes, sometimes for as little as a few hundred dollars.
facts.quote: sometimes for as little as **a few hundred dollars**.

facts.fact: The page says that hiring a full production agency for a traditional TV ad could cost tens of thousands of dollars before the ad airs.
facts.quote: This step alone could set you back tens of thousands of dollars before your ad even saw the light of day.

facts.fact: Adwave states that a broadcast-quality commercial can be running on major channels in a matter of days rather than months.
facts.quote: Now, you can build a broadcast-quality commercial and have it running on major channels in a matter of days, not months.

facts.fact: The page states that the global TV advertising market reached $101.7 billion in 2023.
facts.quote: The global TV advertising market hit **$101.7 billion in 2023** and is expected to soar to **$158.6 billion by 2033**.

facts.fact: The page states that global TV viewership spans nearly two billion households worldwide.
facts.quote: This growth is fueled by viewership in nearly two billion households worldwide.

facts.fact: The page defines CPM as Cost Per Mille, meaning the cost for one thousand views of an ad.
facts.quote: The key metric you need to get comfortable with is **CPM**, which stands for **Cost Per Mille**. It’s just a fancy way of saying "the cost for one thousand views" of your ad.

facts.fact: The page says Adwave budgets can be set at a few hundred dollars or a few thousand dollars.
facts.value: a few hundred dollars or a few thousand
facts.quote: whether that’s a few hundred dollars or a few thousand

facts.fact: The page states the global TV ad market is projected to hit around $103.9 billion in 2025.
facts.quote: The global TV ad market is projected to hit around **$103.9 billion in 2025**

facts.fact: The page states Connected TV (CTV) advertising is growing at 20% each year.
facts.quote: with Connected TV (CTV) growing at a staggering **20%** each year

facts.fact: The page states TV advertising is projected to be a $162.5 billion slice of the $1.08 trillion global ad market in 2025.
facts.quote: It's projected to be a **$162.5 billion** slice of the **$1.08 trillion** global ad market in 2025.

facts.fact: The page states streaming TV alone is already a nearly $42 billion market.
facts.quote: Streaming TV alone is already a nearly **$42 billion** market and growing fast.

facts.fact: The page says Adwave's guidance is to keep a TV commercial to a 30-second length.
facts.quote: When you only have **30 seconds**, every single one counts.

facts.fact: The page defines Reach as the number of unique households that saw a TV ad.
facts.quote: This tells you how many _unique_ households saw your ad.

facts.fact: The page defines Frequency as the average number of times each household saw a TV ad.
facts.quote: This is the average number of times each household saw your ad.

facts.fact: The page defines Impressions as the total number of times a TV ad was seen.
facts.quote: This is simply the total number of times your ad was seen.

facts.fact: The page lists NBC, ABC, and FOX as examples of local broadcast networks Adwave can place ads on.
facts.quote: Think major networks like **NBC, ABC, and FOX**.

facts.fact: The page lists ESPN, HGTV, and the Food Network as examples of top cable channels Adwave can place ads on.
facts.quote: Place your ad on channels like **ESPN, HGTV, or the Food Network**

facts.fact: The page lists Hulu as an example of a streaming/CTV service Adwave can place ads on.
facts.quote: We'll get your ad on services like **Hulu**

facts.fact: Adwave states that a local TV campaign can get started for just a few hundred dollars.
facts.quote: A local TV campaign can get started for just a few hundred dollars.

facts.fact: Adwave states that ad creation is free and users pay only when they run an ad.
facts.quote: Ad creation is free. You only pay when you run your ad, with campaigns starting at $30 a day.

facts.fact: Adwave states that campaigns start at $30 per day, covering media placement on streaming platforms.
facts.quote: with campaigns starting at $30 a day. This covers actual media placement on streaming platforms.

facts.fact: The page states that a professionally produced TV spot could cost $10,000 or more, which is the cost Adwave says it removes by providing templates and tools.
facts.quote: A professionally produced TV spot could easily run you **$10,000 or more**.

facts.fact: Adwave states that its AI generates a professional TV commercial in about 2 minutes after the user provides a website URL or business information.
facts.quote: Adwave's AI generates a professional TV commercial in about 2 minutes after you provide your website URL or business information.

facts.fact: Adwave states that a complete, broadcast-ready ad can be produced in under 10 minutes total, including editing.
facts.quote: you can have a complete, broadcast-ready ad in under 10 minutes total.

facts.fact: Adwave claims it has reduced the traditional ad-on-air timeline from months to just a few days.
facts.quote: we've crushed that entire timeline down from months to just a few days.

facts.fact: Adwave states that users set their budget and the system ensures they never spend more than that amount.
facts.quote: When you use Adwave, you set your budget, and the system makes sure you never spend a penny more.

facts.fact: Adwave describes Connected TV (CTV) as streaming TV that it buys ads on alongside local cable.
facts.quote: Using Adwave to buy ads on local cable and streaming TV (often called Connected TV or CTV)

facts.fact: Adwave states that no existing video footage is required to create an ad, and users may provide a website URL or social media profile as the minimum input.
facts.quote: At minimum, you need a website URL or social media profile. Adwave's AI gathers images, information, and content automatically.
